title: MpiNodes: AGPL-3.0 licence + Cubric Vision funnel, and an upstream-contribution playbook
description: ComfyUi-MpiNodes ships with NO licence file while pyproject.toml points at a nonexistent LICENSE - the Comfy registry currently serves license {"text": "LICENSE"} for 928 downloads. Land AGPL-3.0 to match Cubric-Vision (compatible with ComfyUI GPL-3.0 via GPLv3 s13), fix the pyproject pointer, and add a README line naming the pack as Cubric Vision first-party so the registry listing becomes a funnel instead of an orphan. Second half: a playbook for contributing to THIRD-PARTY upstream repos (first case: a LanPaint fork for LTX 2.5), whose load-bearing rule is that the PR is authored and pushed under Fabio, not an agent.
